findings.answer: The approved spec governs: one line at PR-open, with scope for one appended line only if review asks. The 4-line precedent reflects older runs and does not override the approved spec; this is following the spec, not a departure.
findings.finding: Spec says 'a single line' but same-titled precedents carry four lines (title + three review-round markers); conflict between spec wording and convention.

findings.answer: Spec permits exactly one appended line. Recommended format matching precedent: 'Stage 3 review round 1 (S391574992)' with the base key (no -1). The implementer appends it only if the review requests; tester verifies whatever the review requested, at most one line.
findings.finding: Review-appended-line scope underspecified; precedents append three lines formatted 'Stage 3 review round N (<base key>)'.

findings.answer: Locked: the line MUST contain the literal em dash U+2014. Machine check: grep for the em-dash byte sequence (\xe2\x80\x94) — check B.
findings.finding: Title-line separator is em dash U+2014, not ASCII hyphen; a naive edit could insert '-'.

findings.answer: Locked to .md, matching all same-titled precedents. The .txt variant and its format are out of scope; the sole path is smoke/S391574992-1.md.
findings.finding: File extension ambiguous repo-wide (.md vs .txt with different format).

findings.answer: Required: single trailing LF, LF line endings, no CRLF, no BOM. Machine checks: wc -l == 1 and no CR — check B.
Confirmed by reading the workflow. Acceptance D requires both ci/check and fail-on-demand/gate green, and the change must not add .fail-me.
findings.finding: A second workflow fail-on-demand.yml (job gate) also runs on pull_request and fails if a .fail-me file exists; 'green' needs both.
